metadata.description: Minakami's personal agent plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Grok Build and pi

plugins.name: agent-coord-bootstrap
plugins.description: Scaffold or upgrade an agent-coordination doc layer (AGENTS.md + .agent_works/ + cross-runtime aliases), and review a project's README against best practices for its type. Fresh projects get a clean init; existing projects get a content-preserving migration.

plugins.name: prompt-audit
plugins.description: Audit one prompt's effectiveness for a specific target coding model — token efficiency, goal clarity, confusion/hallucination triggers, capability limiting, and more. Evidence-cited findings tables, an honest verdict, prioritized refinement advice, and an optional approval-gated rewrite. Asks instead of guessing whenever intent is unclear.

plugins.name: code-map
plugins.description: Build an interactive, layered code map of a repository as a local HTML file — architecture overview, module dependency map, algorithm pipeline with typed data flow, and the functions inside each stage. Every node deep-links to your editor and carries typed inputs/outputs, hotspot flags, search, and per-node notes; every edge cites the source line it was seen on, and unconfirmed edges are drawn dashed and labeled inferred.

plugins.name: code-cleanup
plugins.description: Clean up a codebase so a maintainer can read, debug, and change it, without changing what it does — from one targeted change, to removing dead code and junk, to flattening call paths and splitting god functions, to a full overhaul, or a map and plan only. An empty or vague request gets a short survey and one question about the level.

plugins.name: decision-brief
plugins.description: Turn a task's open questions into one decision page a newcomer can answer in one pass: every short name and codename explained in a glossary, one card per question with plain-words background, a vivid real example, options with what each changes and a labelled recommendation, plus Other answers, notes, and comment threads the agent answers live; then read every answer back at once. A local page for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Grok Build and pi, or a claude.ai Artifact when you pick one.
